claims.text: Many reviewers praise the hair as soft, natural-looking, and good quality, often saying it looks like real hair.
Several reviewers complain the wig is not real human hair but a synthetic blend that tangles, mats, and sheds.
Some reviewers say the color does not match the photos, describing it as ginger/burnt orange or darker than pictured.
A number of reviewers report the wig is very thin or lacks density.
Some reviewers note shedding, tangling, or dryness, especially after washing.
